enabled.description: nginx.enabled master switch from deployments/webserver TOML.

gzip.description: Response gzip policy from http.gzip / gzipTypes / gzipMinLength.

proxyCache.description: Shared HTTP response cache (nginx proxy_cache / proxy_cache_path).

providerTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock budget for one Drive or Knowledgebase provider operation (resolution, content open, or validation) in milliseconds.

requestBodyStartTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for the first meaningful request Body Frame after request dispatch begins.

requestBodyIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum idle gap between meaningful request Body Frames after Body progress begins.

responseBodyIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum idle gap between response Body Frames after response processing begins.

connectionWriteTimeoutMs.description: Maximum continuous Pending duration for downstream write, flush, or shutdown operations.

http1KeepAliveIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum HTTP/1 idle wait for a subsequent request after the prior response lifecycle and pending writes complete.

http1MaxPipelineDepth.description: Maximum number of fully read HTTP/1 request heads awaiting service dispatch on one connection. Excess depth closes the connection without buffering request bodies.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: Process-wide admitted request limit across all listeners. Saturation is rejected without queueing, and permits remain held through response Body completion.

maxConcurrentHealthChecks.description: Process-wide active upstream health probe task ceiling for one immutable runtime generation.

maxUriPathBytes.description: Maximum raw URI Path bytes for every HTTP version.

maxDecodedPathBytes.description: Maximum Path bytes after one validated percent-decoding pass without changing routing representation.

maxQueryComponentBytes.description: Maximum raw bytes for each query parameter name or value component.

maxTrailerBytes.description: Maximum encoded bytes for request or response Trailer declarations and actual Trailer fields. Zero disables Trailers together with maxTrailers.

maxTrailers.description: Maximum request or response Trailer field count for declarations and actual Trailer frames. Zero disables Trailers together with maxTrailerBytes.

maxConnectionAgeMs.description: Maximum total lifetime of an accepted HTTP/1 or HTTP/2 connection before protocol-aware graceful retirement. In-flight work may drain only through drainTimeoutMs.

http2KeepAliveIntervalMs.description: Maximum inbound HTTP/2 Frame inactivity before Hyper sends a Keep-Alive PING, including when no streams are active.

http2KeepAliveTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for the corresponding HTTP/2 PING ACK before Hyper sends GOAWAY(NO_ERROR) and closes the connection.

allowPlaintextHttp.description: Explicit opt-in for a public (non-loopback) listener without TLS. Plaintext HTTP on a public listener is otherwise rejected; the exceptions are loopback binds, listeners with `acmeHttp01` (HTTP-01 challenge serving), and this flag.

trustedCidrs.description: Immediate TCP peer networks authorized to supply the configured real-IP Header and one X-Forwarded-Proto request scheme. Omission of trustedProxy trusts no forwarding Header. Semantic validation rejects overbroad networks.

recursive.description: When true, scan right-to-left through trusted proxy hops and select the first non-trusted address; an all-trusted chain resolves to its leftmost address.

trustedSourceCidrs.description: Immediate TCP peer networks authorized to send a mandatory PROXY protocol header.

crc32cPolicy.description: PROXY v2 CRC32C handling. validate-if-present and required need v2 in versions; CRC is integrity detection, not peer authentication.

maxConcurrentQueries.description: Maximum in-flight system DNS lookups for this resolver profile. Saturation fails without queueing.

requestSetHeaders.description: nginx proxy_set_header entries as "Name value" strings.

resourceSubpath.description: Provider-relative path prefix inside the Drive WebsiteRoot served by this resource. Omit to serve the WebsiteRoot itself.

locale.description: Resource-level default locale for wiki route resolution. The request-level Accept-Language header takes precedence when present.

loadBalancing.description: Business-request selection strategy. Hash uses nginx-compatible CRC32 / ketama consistent hashing with hash.key.

maxConnections.description: Aggregate process-local hard ceiling for connecting, active, HTTP/2-multiplexed, and idle physical connections owned by one immutable upstream generation.

maxResponseHeaderBytes.description: Maximum decoded upstream response Header bytes, counted across every field occurrence before proxy forwarding.

maxResponseHeaders.description: Maximum number of decoded upstream response Header field occurrences before proxy forwarding.

idleConnectionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum idle lifetime of a pooled upstream connection before it is removed and the next connection resolves again.

maxInFlightRequests.description: Non-queuing per-upstream admitted request limit held through streaming response completion or cancellation.

allowedCidrs.description: Explicit narrow authorization for loopback, RFC1918, RFC6598, IPv4 link-local, IPv6 ULA, or IPv6 link-local upstream destinations. Public and hard-forbidden ranges cannot be listed.

maxAttempts.description: Total sequential upstream attempts, including the first attempt.

timeoutMs.description: Total wall-clock budget shared by all attempts.

weight.description: Relative business-traffic selection slots among targets that currently pass active and passive health.

backup.description: Reserve this target for selection only when no unattempted primary target is currently eligible.

slowStartMs.description: Optional monotonic interval for recovering effective selection weight from one integer slot to nominal after active or passive unavailability.

maxConnections.description: Optional physical connection ceiling for this unique target authority, including connecting, TLS, active HTTP/1, multiplexed HTTP/2, and idle sockets.
